settings.label: Ingredients
settings.text: Simple, functional ingredients. Each one earns its place through taste, texture, protein, structure or sweetness.

settings.label: Sugar
settings.text: Zero added. Sweetness starts with real food like sweet potato, plus a touch of allulose and monk fruit.

settings.label: Flour
settings.text: Gluten free. Almond flour, egg whites and cocoa, depending on the flavor.

settings.label: Protein
settings.text: Complete protein from egg whites and grass-fed whey isolate. Real macros, printed honestly.

settings.heading: Meet your baker
settings.lede: Hey there, I'm Daniel, the one behind Prodani. Here's how it started.
settings.body:
I'm a personal trainer, so I spend my days with people working hard on their health. I kept watching my clients run into the same wall: they wanted something sweet, and every option set them back. So I asked myself why no bakery made cakes and muffins that taste great and are also high in protein, gluten-free and low in sugar.

I couldn't find one, so I started Prodani. I wanted people like you and me to have dessert without feeling we'd broken our own rules.

Every cake and muffin is made with good ingredients and a lot of care, and I'm picky about quality.

Maybe you train hard, maybe you eat around a dietary restriction, or maybe you just like a good cake. Either way, there's something here for you. Welcome to Prodani.
